purpose: Replace the authenticated calendar fixture path with an authorized DB-backed class calendar.
success_outcome: An authorized Admin, Teacher, Student, or Parent opening `/calendar?classId={classId}&date={YYYY-MM-DD}` receives current class lessons from Center & Scheduling through a server-rendered calendar, while invalid or revoked scope fails before protected lesson data renders.
anti_goals: Do not change the public home fixture or its existing `/` presentation; the authenticated `/calendar` path must stop using that fixture without removing public-home behavior.
Do not implement the calendar lesson-link query contract or modify the existing `/lesson-context` route/module; TASK-038 owns navigation context.
Do not trust client-supplied role, center, class, lesson, or student fields; do not write scheduling, lesson, progress, collaboration, or financial state.

stop_conditions: Stop if `/calendar` cannot consume the existing server Actor Context and Center & Scheduling Calendar and Membership Query Boundary without a new authorization or persistence contract; route to /spec-redesign only for an accepted shared-boundary change.
Stop if the authenticated calendar must read the public home fixture, access Center & Scheduling persistence directly, or change the existing Lesson Context route/module.
Stop if the role/center/class scope cannot be resolved server-side or if the denial matrix cannot prove no protected lesson data and state equality.

constraints: The route server load resolves the request actor through the existing session/Actor Context and reads class scope plus lesson facts through Center & Scheduling's named public query; the component remains presentation-only.

The authenticated `/calendar` path uses current DB-backed LessonView facts and the existing calendar geometry helper only as a pure presenter; it does not invoke the public home fixture's default lesson weekdays.
This task owns the protected calendar read only; exact lesson-link query construction and follow-through belong to TASK-038.
invariants: Every rendered lesson belongs to the server-authorized center/class scope and is not synthesized from fixture weekdays or client role/class fields.
Unauthenticated, revoked, cross-center, non-member, unassigned, and removed requests render no protected lesson data and leave persisted state unchanged.
The public `/` fixture, existing `/lesson-context` owner, FT-004/FT-005/FT-006 ownership, and all completed prerequisite tasks remain unchanged.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-007 / REQ-005 / REQ-014: a fresh isolated real SvelteKit SSR/HTTP matrix exercises four permitted roles plus anonymous/revoked, cross-center, non-member, unassigned, and removed branches; compare status/body, fixture absence, current DB lesson identity/date/status, authorized class scope, complete state snapshots, safe rerun, and cleanup.

Boundary regression: source and generated-build review confirms the route imports only named public queries and the pure calendar presenter, does not modify `/`, `/lesson-context`, Center & Scheduling, or downstream slices, and project-native check/test/build/diff gates pass.
